crime_scene.title: EVERYTHING IS EVIDENCE
crime_scene.objective: Search the crime scene and find the hidden objects.
crime_scene.hint: Every object matters until you know how the crime happened. Free hint: slow, safe. Legal hint: costs money. Illegal hint: fast, but HQ will pretend it never saw it.
crime_scene.success: Lots of objects, zero context. Perfect. That is what the lab is for.

crime_lab.title: SCIENCE DOES THE BORING PART
crime_lab.objective: Go to the Crime Lab and collect the forensic result.
crime_lab.hint: For this first case, the lab has already analysed the evidence. Later, you will have to do it yourself.
crime_lab.success: The lab found something useful. Naturally, they will explain it over the phone.

phone_lab.title: THE NERDS CALL BACK
phone_lab.objective: Answer the Crime Lab call and hear the reconstruction.
phone_lab.hint: The report explains how the theft was carried out. Listen carefully: the method will matter later.
phone_lab.success: Now you know what kind of thief you are looking for.

hypothesis.title: HOW DID THEY DO IT?
hypothesis.objective: Open the Hypothesis scene and reconstruct the crime.
hypothesis.hint: Place the elements in the slots. The system tells you what fits, what almost fits, and what is nonsense. You have 3 tries before it costs you points.
hypothesis.success: Now you know what skills the thief needs. Fewer innocent people to blame.

suspects.title: TEN PEOPLE, ONE THIEF
suspects.objective: Open Suspect Files and exclude people who do not match the main forensic clue.
suspects.hint: You decide who to exclude. The agency will not tell you whether you made the right call.
suspects.success: Your shortlist is ready. Now test it against the rest of the evidence.

suspect_grid.title: THE GRID
suspect_grid.objective: Use the remaining clues to narrow your shortlist to two people.
suspect_grid.hint: The reconstruction tells you which skills the thief needed. Combine it with the other forensic clues.

talk_to_npcs.title: SMALL TALK, BIG ALIBIS
talk_to_npcs.objective: Talk to people in the city and learn the alibis.
talk_to_npcs.hint: Everybody has an alibi. Some of them are even true.

find_liar.title: SOMEBODY IS LYING
find_liar.objective: Check the alibis. Find who lies and who steals.
find_liar.hint: A witness who covers for a thief is still a liar. Compare every story with the timeline.
find_liar.success: The liar is exposed. The thief is next.

arrest.title: NOW COMES THE FUN PART
arrest.objective: Issue the warrant and arrest the thief.
arrest.hint: Wrong person means a lawsuit. Right person means a chase.
arrest.success: Arrest attempted. The thief, however, had other plans.

search_apartment.title: HOME SWEET CRIME SCENE
search_apartment.hint: You may find motive clues, the artefact, and for sure a hint where the thief ran.
search_apartment.success: A trail. Finally, something that is not a coffee stain.

pursuit.title: THE CHASE IS ON
pursuit.objective: Follow the trail and travel to the next city.
pursuit.hint: The thief has a head start. Your budget has a bigger one.
pursuit.success: Tutorial complete. From now on, you are on your own.
